description: This PHP source file defines the AttendancePunchInRecordOverlapAPI class, which provides an API endpoint to check for punch-in record overlaps in an attendance management system. It includes methods for handling GET requests to validate whether a punch-in would overlap with existing records, utilizing date-time calculations with timezone considerations.
